title: Cross-linking of IgG to Protein A or G Beads
author: New England Biolabs
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bhkwj4xe

steps.title: Resuspend and aliquot beads
steps.instruction: Vortex Protein A magnetic beads until thoroughly resuspended, then aliquot 100 µL of the bead suspension into a sterile microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: First two phosphate washes
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of 0.1 M Na‑phosphate buffer (pH 8.0) to the beads, vortex to resuspend, place the tube on a magnetic stand for 30 seconds, and discard the supernatant. Repeat this wash once more (second wash).

steps.title: Add buffer before antibody
steps.instruction: Add 80 µL of 0.1 M Na‑phosphate buffer (pH 8.0) to the washed beads.

steps.title: Bind serum or purified IgG
steps.instruction: Add 15–25 µL serum **or** 20 µg purified IgG (in a total volume not exceeding 30 µL) to the beads, mix thoroughly, and incubate at 4 °C with agitation for 30 minutes. Then place the tube on the magnetic stand, wait 30 seconds, and remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Three phosphate washes
steps.instruction: Perform three consecutive washes with 500 µL of 0.1 M Na‑phosphate buffer (pH 8.0): add buffer, vortex, magnet for 30 seconds, and discard supernatant. Label washes as 1/3, 2/3, and 3/3.

steps.title: Cross‑linking buffer washes
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of cross‑linking buffer (0.2 M triethanolamine, pH 8.2) to the immobilized antibody, vortex, magnet for 30 seconds, and discard supernatant (wash 1/2). Repeat with a second 1 mL addition of the same buffer (wash 2/2).

steps.title: Cross‑link with DMP
steps.instruction: Resuspend the beads in 1 mL of cross‑linking buffer containing 25 mM DMP (6.5 mg DMP per mL of buffer), mix thoroughly, and incubate at room temperature with agitation for 45 minutes. Magnet for 30 seconds and remove the supernatant.

steps.title: First ethanolamine block
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of blocking buffer (0.1 M ethanolamine, pH 8.2), vortex to resuspend, magnet for 30 seconds, and discard supernatant.

steps.title: Second ethanolamine block
steps.instruction: Add another 1 mL of blocking buffer (0.1 M ethanolamine, pH 8.2), vortex, incubate at room temperature with agitation for 30 minutes, then magnet for 30 seconds and remove supernatant.

steps.title: Three PBS washes
steps.instruction: Wash the beads three times with 1 mL PBS: for each wash, add PBS, vortex to resuspend, place on the magnetic stand for 30 seconds, and discard the supernatant. Label washes as 1/3, 2/3, and 3/3.

steps.title: Elute non‑cross‑linked antibody
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL elution buffer (0.1 M glycine‑HCl, pH 2.5), vortex to resuspend, magnet for 30 seconds, and remove the supernatant, which contains antibody that was not cross‑linked with DMP.

steps.title: Store beads in preservation buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the beads in 100 µL PBS containing 0.1 % Tween 20 and 0.02 % sodium azide for storage.

steps.title: Final PBS washes
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL PBS (first half), vortex, magnet for 30 seconds, and discard supernatant. Add a second 1 mL PBS, magnet for 30 seconds, discard supernatant, then vortex to resuspend.
